specification.problem: Implement a single-qubit POVM (trine, SIC or unambiguous state discrimination) as a Naimark dilation by a coined discrete-time quantum walk on 3 qubits (1 polarisation/coin qubit plus 2 position qubits). The scoped instance is the trine POVM, and SIC and USD reuse the same structure with different target elements.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Smallest useful construction: the trine POVM with 3 outcomes on 3 qubits and no black-box queries. The isometry V is built from the target Kraus operators, completed to a unitary on (position, polarisation), and decomposed into u gates and controlled shifts. Outside scope: the optical implementation, a full gate-level SIC or USD angle solution, loss and noise, and paper-specific coin angles, none of which the abstract gives.

symbols.domain: 2x2 positive semidefinite matrices summing to I

symbols.meaning: final position label (2 bits) and polarisation bit

equations.label: POVM completeness and Born rule
equations.description: Defines the POVM and outcome probabilities.
equations.justification: Standard POVM definition; the abstract names POVMs but states no equation.

equations.label: Trine POVM
equations.description: Three elements uniformly distributed on an equatorial great circle of the Bloch sphere.
equations.abstract_quote: the POVM elements uniformly distributed on an equatorial plane of the Bloch sphere
equations.justification: Uniform spacing on an equatorial circle gives 120-degree Bloch spacing. The weight 2/3 follows from completeness. The real-state basis choice is an assumption.
assumptions: Equator is the x-z plane, with real amplitudes

equations.label: Naimark dilation by the walk
equations.description: Two-step coined walk. Labels (x,p) map to outcomes k, with some grouped, so that P(k)=\sum_{(x,p)\in k}P(x,p)=\langle\psi|E_k|\psi\rangle.
equations.justification: Proposed construction from the sketch; the coin angles are not given in the abstract.

equations.label: Isometry condition
equations.description: The walk's first columns form an isometry. Complete V to a 3-qubit unitary and decompose it into u gates and controlled shifts.

equations.label: SIC and USD elements
equations.description: Targets for the other two POVMs: tetrahedral SIC elements and equal-prior USD, whose success probability is 1-|<psi1|psi2>|.
equations.justification: Standard SIC and USD (Ivanovic-Dieks-Peres) results; the abstract only names them.

specification.initial_state: |0>_pos (x) |psi>_pol, with |psi> prepared by standard u/ry/rz gates

steps.description: Fix the target POVM (trine) and its Kraus operators, and prepare the input state |psi> on the polarisation qubit by u gates.
Apply coin C1 followed by the conditional shift S (increment position if pol=1).
Apply coin C2 followed by the shift S2. Angles are solved numerically offline so the outcome channels realise the target K_k and the isometry condition holds.
Measure all 3 qubits and map the (x,p) labels to POVM outcomes. Compare with the Born-rule targets, and with the SIC/USD targets if those variants are run.

specification.measurement: Measure position qubits and polarisation qubit. Little-endian: the counts key is pos bits then pol bit, with pol as the last character, classical bit 0.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Group the (x,p) counts into outcome labels, normalise to get P(k), and compare with <psi|E_k|psi> for several inputs. For USD, report the conclusive and inconclusive probabilities.
assumptions: 2 position qubits suffice for up to 4 outcomes
Total of 3 qubits and no black-box queries
missing_information: Actual coin angles and shift schedule from the paper
Exact mapping of (x,p) labels to outcomes
Orientation of the trine/SIC frames relative to the computational basis
